result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by inconsistent infrastructure, with a narrow sidewalk on one side frequently obstructed by parked vehicles and no clear walkway on the opposite side. The street is dominated by vehicle storage and commercial activity that encroaches into the pedestrian realm, creating numerous conflict points.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked directly on the narrow sidewalk on the left side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved or protected walkway on the right side of the street, where commercial activity is occurring.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars and commercial signage/tents block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Curb Management
interventions.description: Implement physical barriers or stricter enforcement to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The environment lacks any formal pedestrian infrastructure, appearing to be an industrial or commercial service area or alleyway. Pedestrians are forced to share space with vehicles on an unpaved or poorly maintained surface with no separation or designated walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or protected area for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the same space as vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground area where the truck is parked

hazards.name: Poor Surface Condition
hazards.description: The ground surface is uneven and appears to be a mix of dirt, gravel, and degraded pavement, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground surface around the pickup truck

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large pickup truck significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians and any other moving vehicles in the area.

interventions.title: Install Dedicated Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved, raised sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repave the area to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by vehicles parked directly on or over the narrow sidewalks, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The lack of marked crosswalks at the upcoming intersection and the absence of traffic calming measures further reduce safety in this mixed-use area.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked on the left side completely block the pedestrian walkway, forcing people into the street.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians and alert drivers.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street approaching the intersection

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening and protection
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks and install bollards to prevent vehicles from parking on the walkway.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalks at the intersection to formalize pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While the street's narrow geometry likely keeps vehicle speeds low, the pedestrian environment is constrained by sidewalk obstructions and a lack of a buffer from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A utility pole and a trash bin are located directly in the walking path, significantly narrowing the effective width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left and center-right on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the curb line

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles and provide designated areas for trash receptacles to maintain a clear pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersection to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees in a dedicated furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.
